parameters.query:
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT bpn.branch_id FROM voiceai.branch_phone_numbers bpn
  WHERE bpn.phone_number = $2 AND bpn.is_active = true
  LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO voiceai.calls (call_id, branch_id, started_at)
SELECT $1, COALESCE((SELECT branch_id FROM resolved), $3::uuid, '97004c8f-e3fe-41d5-88ef-52fd17c58352'::uuid), now()
WHERE $1 IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE
  SET branch_id = COALESCE(voiceai.calls.branch_id, EXCLUDED.branch_id)
RETURNING branch_id;

SELECT item_id, external_item_id, category, name, description, price, currency, tax_rate,
       spice_level, is_vegetarian, is_vegan, is_jain, is_gluten_free, is_halal,
       allergens, is_bestseller, is_seasonal, modifiers
FROM voiceai.menu_items
WHERE branch_id = $1::uuid
  AND is_available = true
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR category ILIKE $2)
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR spice_level::text = $3)
  AND ($4::boolean IS NULL OR is_bestseller = $4)
  AND ($5::boolean IS NULL OR is_seasonal = $5)
  AND ($6::text IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || $6 || '%')
  AND ($7::text[] IS NULL OR (
        (NOT ($7 @> ARRAY['vegetarian']) OR is_vegetarian) AND
        (NOT ($7 @> ARRAY['vegan']) OR is_vegan) AND
        (NOT ($7 @> ARRAY['jain']) OR is_jain) AND
        (NOT ($7 @> ARRAY['gluten_free']) OR is_gluten_free) AND
        (NOT ($7 @> ARRAY['halal']) OR is_halal)
      ))
  AND ($8::text[] IS NULL OR NOT (allergens && $8))
ORDER BY sort_order NULLS LAST, name
LIMIT 8;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO voiceai.orders (call_id, branch_id)
SELECT $1, c.branch_id FROM voiceai.calls c
WHERE c.call_id = $1 AND c.branch_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE
  SET branch_id = voiceai.orders.branch_id
RETURNING order_id;

WITH ord AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.branch_id FROM voiceai.orders o WHERE o.call_id = $1
),
validated_item AS (
  SELECT mi.item_id, mi.name, mi.price
  FROM voiceai.menu_items mi, ord
  WHERE mi.item_id = $3::uuid AND mi.branch_id = ord.branch_id AND mi.is_available = true
),
do_add AS (
  INSERT INTO voiceai.order_items (order_id, item_id, name_snapshot, unit_price_snapshot, quantity, modifiers)
  SELECT ord.order_id, vi.item_id, vi.name, vi.price, COALESCE($4::int,1), COALESCE($5::jsonb,'[]')
  FROM ord, validated_item vi
  WHERE $2 = 'add'
  RETURNING order_item_id
),
do_remove AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.order_items oi
  USING ord
  WHERE oi.order_id = ord.order_id AND oi.item_id = $3::uuid AND $2 = 'remove'
  RETURNING oi.order_item_id
),
do_update AS (
  UPDATE voiceai.order_items oi
  SET quantity = $4::int
  FROM ord
  WHERE oi.order_id = ord.order_id AND oi.item_id = $3::uuid AND $2 = 'update_quantity'
  RETURNING oi.order_item_id
),
do_clear AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.order_items oi
  USING ord
  WHERE oi.order_id = ord.order_id AND $2 = 'clear'
  RETURNING oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ord) AS order_found,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM do_add) AS added,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM do_remove) AS removed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM do_update) AS updated,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM do_clear) AS cleared,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM validated_item) AS item_valid;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  o.order_id, o.subtotal, o.tax_total, o.total,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'order_item_id', oi.order_item_id,
    'item_id', oi.item_id,
    'name', oi.name_snapshot,
    'unit_price', oi.unit_price_snapshot,
    'quantity', oi.quantity,
    'modifiers', oi.modifiers,
    'line_total', oi.line_total
  ) ORDER BY oi.created_at) FILTER (WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS items
FROM voiceai.orders o
LEFT JOIN voiceai.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.call_id = $1
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.subtotal, o.tax_total, o.total;

WITH expired_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.call_id
  FROM voiceai.orders o
  WHERE o.created_at < (now() - INTERVAL '20 days')
),
del_order_items AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM expired_orders)
  RETURNING oi.order_item_id
),
del_special_instructions AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.call_special_instructions csi
  WHERE csi.call_id IN (SELECT call_id FROM expired_orders)
  RETURNING csi.call_id
),
del_tool_invocations AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.call_tool_invocations cti
  WHERE cti.call_id IN (SELECT call_id FROM expired_orders)
  RETURNING cti.call_id
),
del_orders AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.orders o
  WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM expired_orders)
  RETURNING o.order_id
),
del_calls AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.calls c
  WHERE c.call_id IN (SELECT call_id FROM expired_orders)
  RETURNING c.call_id
),
expired_orderless_calls AS (
  SELECT c.call_id
  FROM voiceai.calls c
  WHERE c.started_at < (now() - INTERVAL '20 days')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM voiceai.orders o WHERE o.call_id = c.call_id)
),
del_orderless_tool_invocations AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.call_tool_invocations cti
  WHERE cti.call_id IN (SELECT call_id FROM expired_orderless_calls)
  RETURNING cti.call_id
),
del_orderless_special_instructions AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.call_special_instructions csi
  WHERE csi.call_id IN (SELECT call_id FROM expired_orderless_calls)
  RETURNING csi.call_id
),
del_orderless_calls AS (
  DELETE FROM voiceai.calls c
  WHERE c.call_id IN (SELECT call_id FROM expired_orderless_calls)
  RETURNING c.call_id
)
SELECT
  now() AS run_at,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM del_orders) AS orders_deleted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM del_order_items) AS order_items_deleted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM del_special_instructions) + (SELECT count(*) FROM del_orderless_special_instructions) AS special_instructions_deleted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM del_tool_invocations) + (SELECT count(*) FROM del_orderless_tool_invocations) AS tool_invocations_deleted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM del_calls) + (SELECT count(*) FROM del_orderless_calls) AS calls_deleted;
